meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: Claude 会借助 dx CLI 和 dxpy 操作 DNAnexus 云平台：上传下载文件、创建 app/applet、运行与监控作业、处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等数据，并可用 dxCompiler 或 Nextflow 编排工作流。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及 DNAnexus 的任务时触发，例如创建或修改 app/applet、上传下载或搜索文件、运行分析或监控作业、编写 dxpy 脚本等。

say.text: 帮我把 sample.fastq 上传到项目 project-xxxx 里
say.note: 会执行上传并返回文件链接

say.text: 用 dxpy 写脚本，批量下载项目里所有 BAM 文件
say.note: 脚本会搜索并逐个下载文件

say.text: 创建一个 app，输入 FASTQ，输出过滤后的 reads
say.note: 会生成 app 骨架和 dxapp.json

howto.what_en: Claude uses the dx CLI and dxpy to operate the DNAnexus cloud platform: upload/download files, build apps/applets, run and monitor jobs, handle FASTQ/BAM/VCF data, and orchestrate workflows with dxCompiler or Nextflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user raises tasks involving DNAnexus, such as creating or modifying apps/applets, uploading/downloading or searching files, running analyses or monitoring jobs, or writing dxpy scripts.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project project-xxxx for me
say_en.note: It will upload and return the file link

say_en.text: Write a dxpy script to batch-download all BAM files in the project
say_en.note: The script will search and download each file

say_en.text: Create an app that takes FASTQ and outputs filtered reads
say_en.note: It will generate the app skeleton and dxapp.json
